name: Phone Split Feature
summary: A split feature section with a headline, supporting text, three icon bullets and a button beside a gradient panel holding a phone whose screen is any node; the phone drifts with scroll, the content staggers in once, and the side can be reversed.
useWhen: A product page explains one capability with a short bullet list next to an app screenshot or mock
Two such sections should alternate sides down the page
The visual should drift gently as the reader scrolls
avoidWhen: The visual is a wide desktop screenshot; use marketing/feature
A section needs many features or tabs; use marketing/product-rail
